acceptance_checks.detail: Original AutoSci native skill document exists.
Solar feature parity route declares a backend action.
Solar $ingest preserves the native source-oriented command surface while routing execution through Solar Harness and Solar-managed artifacts.

Source preparation is completed from a real registered markdown source, PDF extraction/no-fixture-leakage is covered by focused tests, and parsed paper evidence includes paper id, title, sections, source path, and preparation metadata.
The final source registration boundary is ready only after source preparation, parse quality, raw artifact provenance, downstream handoff, and wiki registration checks are all ok.
The route writes memory and graph sidecars that preserve paper identity, evidence ids, source references, and graph edges for downstream wiki/native graph handoff.
The proof run records wiki paper, log, graph edges, index, and context brief registration, and emits provider-source and wiki-mutation runtime proof manifests with concrete evidence refs.
The source-provider proof covers provider_source_evidence and external_runtime_evidence; the wiki registration proof covers wiki_mutation_evidence for the completed registered-source proof run.
The Solar wrapper routes ingestion through Solar Harness and writes Solar-managed artifacts/workspace files; the source AutoSci repo remains an evidence snapshot.

findings.finding: $ingest is semantically full for source-prepared paper ingestion through final Solar workspace wiki registration represented by the supplied proof run.
Network source fetches remain governed by explicit source preparation policy; offline runs must continue to report network-disabled or synthetic-TeX fallback state rather than hiding it.

limitations: PDF and arXiv source preparation writes explicit raw/tmp artifacts; set allow_network_fetch=false for offline synthetic-TeX fallback.

Source-grounded PDF extraction, sample-content leakage guards, and phase9 memory/graph sidecars are covered; ingest_final_source_registration_boundary requires verified source preparation, parse quality, raw provenance, memory/graph handoff, and wiki paper/log/graph/index/context registration before a source is treated as fully registered.

summary: Solar $ingest preserves native AutoSci paper ingestion semantics for source preparation, metadata parsing, memory/graph sidecars, and final wiki registration. The route now proves source preparation, parse quality, raw provenance, downstream memory/graph handoff, and wiki paper/log/graph/index/context registration before treating a source as fully registered, while keeping the original AutoSci checkout read-only.
